summary: Expanded the direct-public-company universe for the AI power constraint node using a two-lane funnel. Reference lane anchors are nuclear/power asset owners with disclosed hyperscaler PPAs. Underfollowed lane prioritizes electrical construction, data-center power installation, transmission/distribution, and substation-capacity service providers that are closer to permitting, interconnection, and execution bottlenecks than to AI headlines.
